kgk-diamonds.about: KGK Diamonds is the buying app of the KGK Group. Professionals search a consolidated inventory of certified diamonds from five sales offices, save searches, share stones, export details to Excel, bid on new arrivals and book viewings at KGK offices.
kgk-diamonds.audience: Retailers, wholesalers, brokers and jewellery designers who buy certified diamonds in volume.
kgk-diamonds.team: 7 people: 2 mobile, 1 backend, 1 web, 1 design, 2 QA. Mitul leads the team and mentors five of them.
contributions: Rebuilt the inventory grid with virtualised lists, server-driven filters and a slimmer payload. Scrolling on entry-level Android went from 50 to 60 FPS and the grid now appears in 2 seconds instead of 5.
Cut app size by 10% and cold start by 45% on mid-tier Android 12 phones through tree-shaking, deferred asset loading and cache priming.
Made Clean Architecture with MVVM and BLoC the team standard. Cross-feature merge conflicts fell about 65% and new engineers became productive in 2 weeks instead of 5.

Protected commercially sensitive pricing: screen capture blocked on pricing screens, the app refuses to start when it detects traffic-sniffing tools, and credentials and cached inventory sit in encrypted storage behind JWT and OAuth 2.0.
Built a test suite of unit, widget and Patrol end-to-end tests at about 80% coverage, run on every pull request.
Owns the release pipeline end to end, including Fastlane signing and store upload. A release takes 1.5 days instead of 4, and crash-free sessions hold at 99.9% on both stores.

foresite.about: ForeSite is the field app of Ukko Agro, a smart-agriculture company. It turns data from on-farm weather stations and crop models into daily insights: which fields need attention, growth stages, disease risk and spray timing, plus field data entry and farm management.
foresite.audience: Growers and agronomists who need to decide what to do on the farm today with little time to spare.
contributions: Built offline-first sync: a local SQLite store that replays changes and resolves conflicts when the connection returns, with request retry and caching, so crop monitoring keeps working in fields with no signal.
Shaped API payloads around what each screen actually shows, to keep map and chart screens quick on weak connections.
Wrote a native bridge in Kotlin and Swift for secure WebSocket telemetry, where Dart alone could not reach the platform.

Built the chat-style assistant and its swipeable reply cards.

Kept personal health data encrypted on the device and accessed accounts read-only.
